message: The other day, my friend Janet called in a bit of a tizzy—she had just seen a news segment about emergency preparedness and was feeling overwhelmed. I listened patiently as she rattled off her worries about go-bags and water supplies. I told her how I keep a little checklist for our family, so we can tackle one thing at a time instead of letting it all pile up. Sometimes it’s just about taking a deep breath and breaking things down into manageable bits, isn’t it? 😊 How do you keep your calm in a storm?
